spans.s: tṛṃhaṇa(-tā), (Skt. Gr., n. act. from the Vedic and Gr. root tṛh), crushing: vātamaṇḍalībhūtaṃ sarvāvaraṇanivaraṇa-tṛṃhaṇa-tayā Gv 〔495.22—23〕, it is like a whirlwind, because it crushes all obstructions and hindrances. But Śikṣ 〔6.6〕, citing this passage, reads ˚tṛṇa-vikiraṇatayā, scattering like grass, for ˚tṛṃh˚.
